title: Proteomics analysis of cystic fluid from human cystic papillary thyroid carcinoma
projectDescription: Here we have performed quantitative and qualitative profiling of the proteome of cystic fluid from human cystic papillary thyroid carcinoma with the aim to identify specific proteins and pathways involved in cystic fluid from human cystic papillary carcinoma, as well as possible diagnostic markers.
sampleProcessingProtocol: Proteins were digested with trypsin, labeled with 8plex iTRAQ and separated by isoelectric focusing before LC-MS/MS on an LTQ Orbitrap Velos.
dataProcessingProtocol: MSMS data was searched using Sequest/Percolator under Proteome Discoverer 1.3 against the Swissprot_human_20121008.fasta  database. Variable mods: oxidation of methionine, phosphorylation on serine, threonine and tyrosine. Fixed mods: carbamidomethylation of cysteine, iTRAQ8plex on N-terminus and on lysine side chains.
